info.description: Universal icon component - supports Lucide icons, emoji, or custom image uploads

iconType.description: Select icon display mode: Lucide (icon library), Emoji (character), or Custom (upload)

lucideName.description: Lucide icon name (e.g., 'Mail', 'Phone', 'MapPin', 'Clock'). Browse all icons: https://lucide.dev/icons/

customImage.description: Upload custom icon image (SVG, PNG). Overrides lucideName and emoji if iconType is 'custom'

size.description: Icon size: sm (16px), md (20px), lg (24px), xl (32px)
